rationale: The interpreter identified several unresolved ambiguities that are not addressed in the ticket. Clarification is required for each ambiguity before implementation can proceed.

findings.description: Unclear whether recalculation should be triggered by edits to any Cooling Circuit Height, edits to DX Coil Height itself, or both.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on which height edits should trigger the DX Coil Height recalculation.

sourceRefs.quote: It is unclear whether the recalculation should be triggered by edits to any Cooling Circuit Height, edits to DX Coil Height itself, or both.

findings.description: No rounding or precision rules are specified for the sum of heights.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the rounding or precision policy for the summed DX Coil Height.

sourceRefs.quote: No rounding or precision rules are specified for the sum of heights.

findings.description: Unclear whether only active/enabled Cooling Circuits should be included in the sum.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on whether the calculation should consider only active/enabled Cooling Circuits.

sourceRefs.quote: The ticket does not specify whether only active/enabled Cooling Circuits should be included in the sum.

findings.description: The mechanism for the immediate recalculation (e.g., UI event, backend process) is not defined.
findings.action: Obtain clarification from the ticket owner on the required mechanism for triggering the immediate recalculation after a height edit.

sourceRefs.quote: The mechanism for the immediate recalculation (e.g., UI event, backend process) is not defined.
